title: Cash drag
description: Is idle cash costing me? What's uninvested, where it sits, and what it gives up

blocks.label: Idle cash
blocks.deltaLabel: of your book is sitting uninvested
blocks.caption: Some cash is healthy: a buffer, or dry powder for the next idea. Past that, it's money not working.

items.label: What it gives up
items.hint: a year, at a 7% long-run market return

blocks.title: Where it sits
blocks.subtitle: Uninvested cash in each account, and how much of that account it is
blocks.label: account

blocks.text: 7% is an illustrative long-run equity return, not a forecast. If your cash earns interest, the real cost is lower; if markets fall, idle cash is what lets you buy.
